description: This file defines data models, query parameters, and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing the latest financial reports from the SEC EDGAR database, including URL construction, data extraction, validation, and transformation.

classes.name: SecLatestFinancialReportsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching SEC latest financial reports, including date and report type with validation.

classes.name: SecLatestFinancialReportsData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for individual SEC financial report entries, including URLs and metadata.

classes.name: SecLatestFinancialReportsFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching, paginating, and transforming SEC financial report data asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a SecLatestFinancialReportsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches SEC data based on query parameters, handling pagination and errors.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw SEC data into structured SecLatestFinancialReportsData instances.
